purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: The City of Lipa documents an assessor tax-mapping service for property location/boundary verification, while copies are limited to owners or authorized representatives presenting title and tax-declaration documents. The public map catalog lists static thematic maps. No anonymous parcel-vector service or geometry endpoint was identified. No property identifiers were submitted.
registryAssessment: The official City of Lipa describes an assessor tax-mapping division that can verify property location/boundaries. Its published map-request workflow is for the property owner or authorized representative and asks for title and tax declaration; no anonymous vector service was identified.
